#compdef tur
# zsh completion for tur -- generated by `tur completion zsh`.
#
# Install into your fpath:
#   tur completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_tur" && compinit
# or source it directly from ~/.zshrc:
#   source <(tur completion zsh)

(( $+functions[__tur_recipes] )) || __tur_recipes() {
  local -a lines out parts
  local line name desc
  lines=( ${(f)"$(_call_program tur-recipes ${__tur_bin} run --list 2>/dev/null)"} )
  for line in $lines; do
    parts=( ${(z)line} )
    name=${parts[1]}
    [[ -n $name ]] || continue
    if [[ $line == *'#'* ]]; then
      desc=${${line#*\#}## }
    else
      desc=''
    fi
    out+=( "${name}:${desc}" )
  done
  (( $#out )) && _describe -t recipes 'recipe' out
}

(( $+functions[__tur_run_target] )) || __tur_run_target() {
  _alternative \
    'recipes:recipe:__tur_recipes' \
    'files:turmeric file:_files -g "*.tur(|.sweet)"'
}

(( $+functions[__tur_experiments] )) || __tur_experiments() {
  local -a lines out parts
  local line
  lines=( ${(f)"$(_call_program tur-experiments ${__tur_bin} experiments 2>/dev/null)"} )
  for line in $lines; do
    parts=( ${(z)line} )
    [[ ${parts[1]} == [a-z]* ]] || continue
    out+=( ${parts[1]} )
  done
  (( $#out )) && _describe -t experiments 'experiment' out
}

(( $+functions[__tur_files] )) || __tur_files() {
  _files -g '*.tur(|.sweet)'
}

_tur() {
  local curcontext="$curcontext" state line ret=1
  typeset -A opt_args

  # Captured before any nested _arguments shifts `words`: inside the
  # per-subcommand dispatch below, words[1] is the SUBCOMMAND, not the binary.
  # zsh scopes locals dynamically, so the __tur_* helpers see this.
  local __tur_bin=${words[1]:-tur}

  local -a commands
  commands=(
    'build:build a file or directory into an executable'
    'compile:lower a .tur to an object file'
    'link:link objects into an executable'
    'emit-c:print the generated C to stdout'
    'emit-h:print the generated header to stdout'
    'run:run a Justfile recipe, or build and execute a .tur file'
    'just:synonym for run'
    'repl:interactive REPL'
    'worker:persistent fixture evaluator'
    'interpret:run a file through the tree-walking interpreter'
    'debug:run a file under the interactive debugger'
    'dap:Debug Adapter Protocol server'
    'trace:record an interpreted run, or read one back'
    'lsp-lite:lightweight completion/calltip/doc backend'
    'eval:evaluate an inline expression'
    'doc:print documentation for a symbol'
    'docs:locate, open, or serve the rendered guides'
    'explain:explain a diagnostic code or snippet'
    'test:run all .tur files in a directory'
    'check:type-check only, no codegen'
    'expand:trace macro expansions while checking'
    'format:format a single source file or stdin'
    'fmt:format sources in place, walking directories'
    'parse-check:exit 0 if two files read to the same AST'
    'demangle:decode mangled C symbols back to Turmeric names'
    'smt:run an SMT-LIB2 script through the refinement solver'
    'experiments:list experimental features'
    'dialects:list the base dialects a #lang line may name'
    'completion:print a shell completion script'
    'init:create a new project in the current directory'
    'add:add a Turmeric spice dependency'
    'add-cmake:add a C/CMake dependency'
    'fetch:download or update declared spices'
    'audit:list every origin the build fetches code from'
    'emit-cmake:generate CMakeLists.txt for CMake consumers'
    'install:install a spice binary globally'
    'uninstall:remove a globally installed spice'
    'list:list globally installed spices'
    'upgrade:upgrade globally installed spices'
    'cache:list or clean the script-dep cache'
    'new:scaffold a new spice'
    'audit-spans:report source-span coverage'
    'lsp:Language Server Protocol server'
    'mcp:Model Context Protocol server'
    'image-info:print metadata for a compiled image'
    'image-verify:verify a compiled image'
    'jit:build and run a file in process through the MIR JIT'
  )

  _arguments -C \
    '(- *)'{-h,--help}'[show help and exit]' \
    '(- *)'{-V,-v,--version}'[show version and exit]' \
    '--no-color[disable colored diagnostics]' \
    '--json[structured JSON output]' \
    '--json-diagnostics[emit diagnostics as JSON]' \
    '--enable=[turn on an experimental feature]:experiment:__tur_experiments' \
    '--strict-effects[warn on unannotated effectful functions]' \
    '-Werror\=strict-effects[make the --strict-effects warnings errors]' \
    '--strict-refine[hard-fail unproven refinement obligations]' \
    '--no-contracts[strip contract checks]' \
    '--keep-contracts[retain contract checks in release builds]' \
    '--warn-unused-result[warn on discarded result values]' \
    '--panic-abort[all panics call abort() directly]' \
    '--no-auto-spice[do not auto-discover the enclosing build.tur]' \
    '--no-global-spices[outside a project, do not search installed spices]' \
    '1: :->command' \
    '*:: :->args' && ret=0

  case $state in
    command)
      _describe -t commands 'tur command' commands && ret=0
      ;;
    args)
      case ${words[1]} in
        run|just)
          _arguments \
            '(-l --list)'{-l,--list}'[list recipes]' \
            '(-a --all)'{-a,--all}'[with --list: include private and _-prefixed recipes]' \
            '--json[machine-readable recipe list]' \
            '--dry-run[print resolved commands without executing]' \
            '--verbose[echo recipe metadata to stderr]' \
            '--justfile[use an explicit Justfile]:justfile:_files' \
            '--chdir[run the recipe from DIR]:directory:_files -/' \
            '--init[write a starter Justfile into cwd]' \
            '--force[overwrite an existing Justfile]' \
            '--release[build with optimizations (.tur file mode)]' \
            '1: :__tur_run_target' \
            '*::recipe argument:_default' && ret=0
          ;;
        build)
          _arguments \
            '(-o)-o[output path]:output:_files' \
            '(-B --build-dir)'{-B,--build-dir}'[build output directory]:directory:_files -/' \
            '--release[build with optimizations]' \
            '--shared[build a shared library]' \
            '--watch[rebuild on source changes]' \
            '*-I+[add a module search directory]:directory:_files -/' \
            '*:turmeric file:_files -g "*.tur(|.sweet)"' && ret=0
          ;;
        check|emit-c|emit-h|compile|interpret|debug|parse-check|audit-spans|format)
          _arguments \
            '*-I+[add a module search directory]:directory:_files -/' \
            '*:turmeric file:__tur_files' && ret=0
          ;;
        fmt)
          _arguments \
            '--check[exit non-zero if reformatting is needed]' \
            '--diff[print a diff instead of rewriting]' \
            '--dry-run[report what would change]' \
            '*:path:_files' && ret=0
          ;;
        test)
          _arguments '*:directory:_files -/' && ret=0
          ;;
        link)
          _arguments \
            '(-o)-o[output path]:output:_files' \
            '*:object:_files' && ret=0
          ;;
        init|new)
          _arguments \
            '--bin[scaffold an executable project]' \
            '--lib[scaffold a library project]' \
            '--sweet[use sweet-expression syntax for the manifest]' \
            '*:name:_files -/' && ret=0
          ;;
        add|add-cmake)
          _arguments \
            '--path[treat the argument as a local path]' \
            '--ref[pin to a tag or revision]:ref:' \
            '--workspace[assert a workspace sibling]' \
            '*:spice:_files -/' && ret=0
          ;;
        fetch)
          _arguments \
            '--update[update to the newest allowed revision]' \
            '--dry-run[report what would be fetched]' \
            '--refetch[bypass system packages]' && ret=0
          ;;
        install|uninstall|upgrade)
          _arguments \
            '--path[treat the argument as a local path]' \
            '--all[apply to every installed spice]' \
            '*:spice:_files -/' && ret=0
          ;;
        list)
          _arguments \
            '--verbose[show install paths and versions]' \
            '--outdated[only show spices with newer releases]' && ret=0
          ;;
        emit-cmake)
          _arguments '--output-dir[write into DIR]:directory:_files -/' && ret=0
          ;;
        repl)
          _arguments \
            '--watch[reload the spice cache on source changes]' \
            '*:turmeric file:__tur_files' && ret=0
          ;;
        completion)
          _arguments '1:shell:(zsh bash)' && ret=0
          ;;
        experiments)
          _arguments '1:experiment:__tur_experiments' && ret=0
          ;;
        image-info|image-verify)
          _arguments '*:image:_files' && ret=0
          ;;
        *)
          _default && ret=0
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac

  return ret
}

_tur "$@"
[exit 0]
